claimed_title: Executive Order 5247—Retention of Edwin V. Morgan in the Foreign Service
text:
Executive Order 5247. December 23, 1929
Retention of Edwin V. Morgan in the Foreign Service
Under the authority provided in subsection (d), section 18, of the act approved
May 24, 1924, the President of the United States, in the exercise of his discretion,
and acting in the interest of the United States, hereby orders the retention on active
476
 
Herbert Hoover, 1929-1933 EO 5248
duty for such time as may be deemed necessary not in excess of five years from Febru-
ary 22, 1930, of Edwin V. Morgan, of New York, ambassador extraordinary and
plenipotentiary to Brazil.
HERBERT HOOVER
The White House,
December 23, 1929.
[No. 5247]
